behavior.name: 0x13002178
behavior.description: A fish that roams the water. It constantly checks if it is still submerged; if it leaves the water (unless the 'sIn Full Water Level's flag is set), it is marked for deletion. Its movement and actions are managed via the sFishActions function array.

field.name: Flags
field.description: Flags for fish behavior, such as whether it is in a fully submerged level.
